previews.body:
Dear Allyson Overmier,

I’m reaching out about the Software Engineering Intern opportunity at Nvidia.

I’m especially interested in contributing to Nvidia’s engineering team and learning from the work you do.

I’ve built data systems and automation tools using Python and SQL, and shipped production features with testing and CI.

Why me for this role:

  • I have experience collaborating across teams to deliver production-ready systems.
  • In my previous role, I built and automated data workflows to improve reliability and speed.

Resume attached; happy to discuss if there’s a fit.

Core Skills: Python, JavaScript, Flask, React, AI/ML, Automation

Best regards,

Anamay Tripathy
Software Engineering Intern
India
tripathy.anamay23@gmail.com

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Software Engineer role at Test Corp.

As a Data Science Engineering student at MIT Manipal, I have developed strong technical skills and a passion for innovation. 

In my previous role at YaanBarpe, I led the development of ML-powered systems, resulting in a 34% efficiency improvement. 

Additionally, at Intellect Design Arena, I processed 2.3M daily transactions, further refining my ability to handle large-scale data.

I am confident that my technical expertise and experience make me a strong fit for this role. 

I look forward to discussing my application and how I can contribute to Test Corp's success.

Sincerely,
Anamay Tripathy
